summary.text: Sam Alexander is the Republican candidate for Missouri State Senate District 28 in the November 3, 2026 general election, after winning the August 4 Republican primary.
According to his campaign website, he is a board-certified emergency room physician.

paragraphs.text: Sam Alexander says on his campaign website that he and his wife live on their farm in Fair Play, Missouri.

He states that he earned his BA/MD from UMKC Medical School in 1982 and has been a board-certified emergency room physician for more than 30 years, serving as a senior partner with the Emergency Physicians of Springfield, which is affiliated with Cox Health Systems.
He also says he has been a non-paid director of rural Southwest Missouri fire and rescue districts for over thirty years and has been a pilot since 1984.
Alexander ran in the 2022 Republican primary for Missouri's 7th Congressional District and lost, according to Ballotpedia.
His campaign website lists protecting the unborn, Second Amendment rights, border security and medical freedom among his key issues.
